chunks: Everything in this book that is from ʿAbdullāh ibn Faḍālah, I have narrated from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Bundār ibn Ḥammād, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Faḍālah.

key_terms.السَّعْدَآبَادِيِّ: the attribution of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: part of the name Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ: the narrator from whom these reports are transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbdullāh ibn Faḍālah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits reports from ʿAbdullāh ibn Faḍālah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission route of the hadith material rather than presenting a legal or theological teaching.
